signatures.core: Attackers that hit you while you are below 50% HP are burned.
signatures.clutch: A lethal hit leaves you at 20% HP instead of fainting.
signatures.drawback: Healing cannot raise you above 70% of max HP.

signatures.core: Burned or poisoned foes take an extra 3% of max HP each turn.
signatures.drawback: Your direct damage is 10% lower.
